rules.rule: Coverage counts only the unit's own tests run in isolation
must: Coverage a unit picks up from a caller's tests or a\s+parent component's tests does not count
The unit — never the file or the\s+directory — is the unit of work

rules.rule: Coverage thresholds are never lowered; the config is never edited to measure
must: Never lower a threshold to pass

rules.rule: Finish and verify one unit before the next
must: Never start unit B until unit A's loop is\s+complete and verified

rules.rule: A filter matching no test is an uncovered unit, not a clean one
must: that is an uncovered unit, not a clean one

rules.rule: File, directory, and all targets present a plan and wait before writing
must: Wait\s+for approval, then run steps 3–4 unit by unit

rules.rule: Report numbers come off the finished artifacts
must: Every number is read off the finished artifacts
